assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a printable game poster texture, portrait 3:4 rectangle, approximately 1024x1365, fully opaque. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and sole artwork reference: a screenshot of a weathered beach travel poster on an interior wall. Reconstruct JUST THE POSTER as an isolated perfectly straight-on flat full-bleed rectangular printed paper texture. Preserve the reference's actual artwork composition: hazy desaturated blue-grey sky filling the upper half, large cream-white clouds rising up on the left, low straight dark-blue sea horizon just below the middle, horizontal small surf bands, pale sandy beach below, an off-white bottom caption band with the SAME abstract unreadable block letter shapes. Keep its faded late twentieth century institutional travel advert and low-resolution / pixelated old game aesthetic. Keep paper speckling, creases and subdued aged cream edges but do not add new tears. Do not infer or invent readable words; reproduce only the rough unreadable caption glyph silhouettes from the screenshot. Critical: remove all room/wall, tape, bed, boxes, perspective distortion, cast shadows and scene lighting. The poster edges meet all four image boundaries with no margin, no frame, no drop shadow. Even flat neutral illumination suitable for physically lit game material. No additional subject, no people, no sun disc, no brand, no watermark, no new slogans. This is extraction and front-facing reconstruction of the pictured poster, not a scene render.
assets.interactionText: 这里是我的故乡…但我从没去过海边

review.notes: Observed in generated output: blue sky, cream cloud at left, straight sea horizon, surf and sand, low-resolution abstract caption glyphs, weathered paper. Unreadable source typography was not decoded.
